title: Construct CNT and functionalized CNT models
action: Generate atomic coordinates for three (6,6) armchair CNT supercells (120 C atoms): pristine tube (P-CNT), a tube with a Stone‑Wales defect (SW-CNT), and a tube with a monovacancy (MV-CNT). For each CNT, create three functionalized variants by attaching atomic oxygen (ether‑like on P-CNT, bridge on SW-CNT, dangling‑C passivation on MV-CNT), a hydroxyl group (-OH), and a carboxyl group (-COOH) at the specified adsorption sites. Output twelve starting structures for subsequent DFT calculations.
description: Builds the initial atomic models for all bare and functionalized CNTs as required by the DFT protocol, recording the generation in a log file.

title: DFT calculations and binding energy extraction
action: Using SIESTA with the PBE functional, DZP basis set, 150 Ry mesh cutoff, and 5 k‑points along the tube axis, perform spin‑polarized geometry optimizations for each of the 12 CNT models (without Cu) and for the corresponding 12 CNT+Cu complexes (single Cu placed near the oxygen/functional group), applying periodic boundary conditions with 6 Å lateral vacuum. From the optimized total energies, compute the BSSE‑corrected binding energy via Eb = E(CNT+Cu) − E(CNT) − E(Cu_atom). Produce a CSV file binding_energies.csv with one row per configuration, containing the system identifier and the calculated Eb (eV). Include rows for the three bare CNT baselines.
description: BSSE‑corrected binding energies for all 12 configurations.
output_schema: CSV with columns: system (str), Eb (float, eV). Exactly 12 data rows.
